workflow_summary: The workflow consists of utility modules (classes, tools) imported by an orchestrator (main) and a documentation generator. Classes define data models used by the logic engine (tools). The main script orchestrates the process and writes output profiles/summaries. Documentation generates a workbook independently but relies on the same tooling.

nodes.label: Data Models
nodes.order_evidence: Base module with no dependencies, imported by tools.py. Assigned first in Stage Z.

nodes.label: Dependency Logic
nodes.order_evidence: Imports classes.py and is imported by main.py/documentation.py. Assigned second in Stage Z.

nodes.label: Orchestrator
nodes.order_evidence: Entry point script importing tools. Assigned third in Stage Z.

nodes.label: Documentation Generator
nodes.order_evidence: Imports tools but writes distinct output (workbook). Assigned to Stage E for reporting.

edges.evidence: tools.py imports classes (ScriptDependencyProfile, etc.) from classes module.
main.py imports tools module to execute workflow logic.
documentation.py imports tools module for dependency detection logic.

unresolved_items: tools.py reads prompt files (prompt_detect_imports.md, etc.) which are not written by any script in the profile.
main.py writes output files (profiles.json, workflow_network.json, summaries.json) that are not read by other scripts.
documentation.py writes to a dynamic workbook_path variable rather than a static file path.
No data dependency exists between main.py and documentation.py outputs as they write to different resources.
